summary: 全向无线电干扰设备通过发射不同频率的电子干扰信号，对无人机的控制链路、导航链路 and 图传链路进行压制式干扰，从而迫使无人机自动降落或将其驱离，保障低空空域安全，是大型活动和重要场所的安全卫士。 图1无线电干扰设备（全向）
summary_en: The omni-directional RF jammer emits electronic interference signals across various frequencies to suppress the control, navigation, and video transmission links of drones. This forces drones to land automatically or leave the area, securing low-altitude airspace. It serves as a reliable security guard for large events and critical locations.
key_application: 应用领域：干扰类型多；设备可切断常见消费级、行业级无人机、航模机、穿越机、DIY改装无人机的导航信号、遥控信号、图传信号，从而达到对无人机的返航、迫降效果。；导航干扰全
key_application_en: Supressive jamming against consumer, industrial, FPV, and DIY drones; 360° omni-directional defense covering GPS, GLONASS, Beidou, and Galileo navigation; stable performance for 24/7 outdoor security.
key_parameter_1: 干扰距离: 1.5km-2km（根据无线电环境和机型不同会有一定差异）

parameters.干扰距离: 1.5km-2km（根据无线电环境和机型不同会有一定差异）

detail_html:
功能特点

  • 全向覆盖发射干扰信号，支持360°全防空防御。
  • 干扰类型广泛，支持消费级、行业级、穿越机及DIY无人机。
  • 全面导航针对性干扰，覆盖GPS、GLONASS、北斗及伽利略。
  • 支持干扰频段的单独、组合、同时发射。
  • 高性能稳定干扰，信号无频偏，适应全天候户外作业。
  • Figure 1 Omni-directional RF Jammer
detail_html_en:
Features

  • 360° Omni-directional coverage to suppress drone control, navigation, and video links simultaneously.
  • Wide target compatibility: works against common consumer, industry, FPV, and custom DIY drones.
  • Comprehensive navigation interference: blocks signals from GPS, GLONASS, Beidou, and Galileo.
  • Selectable jamming bands: transmit signals individually, in combinations, or all at once.
  • Industrial-grade stability: consistent signal output with no frequency drift; waterproof and dustproof for 24/7 outdoor missions.
category_primary: Anti-Drone / C-UAS Systems (反无人机系统)
category_tertiary: RF Jamming Systems [Directional & Omni] (无线电干扰设备 - 定向/全向)
